comparison.objective: Position, unfold, level, and switch on a foldable desk lamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Base placement and serial passive-hinge articulation.
comparison.success_condition: Base inside frame, shade at least 20 cm high and within 15° of horizontal, lamp on.
comparison.reason: Multi-hinge unfolding does not involve a coupled adjustment screw and jam nut or retained-cycle test.
